quotes/seraphim-acquire-spirit-peace/tex: Seraphim of Sarov is remembered for teaching that the goal of the Christian life is the acquisition of the Holy Spirit, and that one who acquires inner peace will help thousands around him to be saved.
quotes/luther-garland-prayer/text: Luther advised praying through each petition of the Lord’s Prayer and each commandment as a garland of four strands: instruction, thanksgiving, confession and prayer, keeping the heart bound to the Word.
quotes/calvin-prayer-exercise-faith/text: Calvin called prayer the chief exercise of faith, by which believers daily receive God’s benefits; it rests on God’s promises in the Word and is offered through Christ the only mediator.
quotes/molinos-annihilation/text: Molinos taught that the soul should rest in God in silent, passive faith, annihilating its own will and activity, and not be troubled by distractions or temptations.
quotes/merton-contemplation-awareness/te: Merton described contemplation as a vivid awakening to the reality of God within and beyond us, a gift rather than a technique, which frees the true self from the illusions of the false self.
quotes/keating-consent/text: Keating taught that in Centering Prayer one does not empty the mind as a technique but consents to God’s presence and action within, returning gently to a sacred word when distracted.
quotes/augustine-believe-that-thou-mayes: Understanding is the reward of faith. Therefore seek not to understand that thou mayest believe, but believe that thou mayest understand
quotes/anselm-believe-in-order-to-unders: For I do not seek to understand that I may believe, but I believe in order to understand.
quotes/abelard-doubting-inquiry/text: Abelard argued that by doubting we are led to inquiry, and by inquiry we perceive the truth; apparent contradictions among authorities should therefore be examined, not suppressed.
quotes/ockham-plurality-necessity/text: Ockham repeatedly held that a plurality of entities should not be posited without necessity, the principle later nicknamed "Ockham’s razor"; theology must rest on faith and revelation where reason cannot demonstrate.
quotes/luther-aristotle-darkness/text: Luther declared in his 1517 theses that one does not become a theologian with Aristotle but only without him; the whole of Aristotle stands to theology as darkness to light.
quotes/erasmus-paraclesis-ploughboy/text: Erasmus wished the Scriptures translated into every language, so that the farmer might sing them at the plough and the weaver hum them at the loom: the philosophy of Christ is for all, not for theologians alone.
quotes/perkins-science-of-living-blessed: Theology is the science of living blessedly for ever.
quotes/spener-practice-not-knowledge/tex: Spener urged that Christianity consists not in knowledge but in practice, and that theological students should be trained in godliness as well as learning, with Scripture read in small gatherings.
quotes/toland-nothing-above-reason/text: Toland contended that there is nothing in the Gospel contrary to reason, nor above it, and that no Christian doctrine can properly be called a mystery.
quotes/kant-courage-own-understanding/te: Kant defined enlightenment as humanity’s emergence from self-incurred immaturity, with the motto "Sapere aude": dare to use your own understanding without another’s guidance.
quotes/bultmann-demythologise/text: Bultmann argued that one cannot use electric light and the radio and at the same time believe in the New Testament world of spirits and miracles; the kerygma must therefore be demythologised and interpreted existentially.
quotes/tillich-ultimate-concern/text: For Tillich, faith is the state of being ultimately concerned, and God is not a being among others but the ground and power of being itself.
quotes/florovsky-mind-of-the-fathers/tex: Florovsky called Orthodox theologians to acquire "the mind of the Fathers": not to repeat their words but to think in their spirit, in a creative neo-patristic synthesis free from Western scholastic and idealist captivity.
quotes/lossky-no-mysticism-without-theol: Lossky held that in the Eastern tradition there is no Christian mysticism without theology and no theology without mysticism: dogma is lived experience of union with God.
quotes/de-lubac-natural-desire/text: De Lubac argued that the Fathers and Aquinas knew no self-enclosed "pure nature": the human spirit is made with a natural desire for the vision of God that only grace can fulfil.
quotes/leo-xiii-restore-aquinas/text: Leo XIII urged bishops to restore the golden wisdom of St Thomas and spread it far and wide as the surest defence of the faith against modern errors.
quotes/lindbeck-doctrine-grammar/text: Lindbeck proposed that church doctrines work less as first-order truth claims or expressions of inner experience than as communally authoritative rules, like grammar, for Christian speech and practice.
quotes/milbank-secular-reason/text: Milbank argued that once there was no "secular": secular reason is not neutral but a rival theology and ontology of violence, which Christianity must out-narrate with its ontology of peace.
quotes/cone-god-of-oppressed/text: Cone argued that the God of the Exodus and of Jesus is the God of the oppressed, so that in a racist society Christian theology must be Black theology, a theology of liberation.
quotes/ruether-full-humanity/text: Ruether proposed as the critical principle of feminist theology that whatever denies, diminishes or distorts the full humanity of women is not redemptive, while whatever promotes it is of the holy.
quotes/williams-hagar-survival/text: Williams read the story of Hagar, the enslaved woman whom God meets in the wilderness, as a key to Black women’s faith: God gives survival and quality of life rather than always liberation.
quotes/koyama-waterbuffalo-para/text: Koyama described starting his sermons not from Thomas Aquinas or Karl Barth but from the needs of the farmers he met in the muddy rice fields of northern Thailand with their water buffaloes.
quotes/yong-many-tongues/text: Yong argued that the Day of Pentecost, when the Spirit enabled many tongues to declare God’s works, legitimises many contextual theologies held together by the one Spirit.
quotes/barth-harnack-1923/text: In the 1923 exchange Harnack asked whether a theology that despised historical science and general culture could avoid becoming arbitrary; Barth replied that theology’s task is the Word of God, which historical-critical reconstruction can neither give nor take away.
quotes/justin-second-place/text: Our teacher of these things is Jesus Christ… and that we reasonably worship Him, having learned that He is the Son of the true God Himself, and holding Him in the second place, and the prophetic Spirit in the third, we will prove.
quotes/irenaeus-two-hands/text: For with Him were always present the Word and Wisdom, the Son and the Spirit, by whom and in whom, freely and spontaneously, He made all things.
quotes/tertullian-crucified-father/text: By this Praxeas did a twofold service for the devil at Rome: he drove away prophecy, and he brought in heresy; he put to flight the Paraclete, and he crucified the Father.
quotes/tertullian-dispensation-trinity/t: …the mystery of the dispensation is still guarded, which distributes the Unity into a Trinity, placing in their order the three Persons—the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost: three, however, not in condition, but in degree; not in substance, but in form; not in power, but in aspect; yet of one substance, and of one condition, and of one power.
quotes/origen-eternal-generation/text: Origen argues that God was never without his Wisdom; the Son is begotten eternally, as brightness from light, so that there was no point at which the Son did not exist.
quotes/arius-son-has-beginning/text: We are persecuted, because we say that the Son has a beginning, but that God is without beginning.
quotes/athanasius-always-father/text: Athanasius argues that if the Son is the Father's own Word and Wisdom, then to say ‘there was once when He was not’ is to say God was once without reason and wisdom — and that the Father was not always Father.
quotes/jerome-world-groaned/text: The whole world groaned, and was astonished to find itself Arian.
quotes/basil-ousia-hypostasis/text: The distinction between ousia and hypostasis is the same as that between the general and the particular; as, for instance, between the animal and the particular man.
quotes/gregory-nazianzus-one-three/text: No sooner do I conceive of the One than I am illumined by the Splendour of the Three; no sooner do I distinguish Them than I am carried back to the One.
quotes/gregory-nazianzus-spirit-gradual/: The Old Testament proclaimed the Father openly, and the Son more obscurely. The New manifested the Son, and suggested the Deity of the Spirit. Now the Spirit Himself dwells among us, and supplies us with a clearer demonstration of Himself.
quotes/gregory-nyssa-not-three-gods/text: Gregory of Nyssa argues that because every divine action toward creation issues from the Father, proceeds through the Son and is perfected in the Holy Spirit as one single operation, the persons cannot be counted as three gods the way three human beings are counted as three men.
quotes/augustine-lover-beloved-love/text: Now love is of some one that loves, and something is loved with love. Behold, then, there are three things: he that loves, and that which is loved, and love.
quotes/augustine-three-persons-speech/te: Augustine admits that when asked ‘three what?’ human speech labours under great poverty; we say ‘three persons’ not in order to say something exact, but so as not to remain silent.
quotes/photius-father-alone/text: Photius argues that if the Spirit proceeded from both the Father and the Son, there would be two causes in the Godhead — or else the Father's distinctive property of being cause would be shared with the Son, confusing the persons and destroying the monarchy of the Father.
quotes/aquinas-person-relation/text: Aquinas teaches that a divine person signifies a relation as subsisting: paternity is the Father, filiation the Son, procession the Holy Spirit — really distinct from one another, yet each identical with the one divine essence.
quotes/channing-unity-of-god/text: Channing holds that Scripture teaches the unity of God as one being and one person, and that the doctrine of three persons, each fully God, is irreconcilable with that unity and with the plain sense of the Bible.
quotes/rahner-rule/text: Rahner's axiom: the Trinity revealed in the history of salvation (the ‘economic’ Trinity) is the Trinity as God is in himself (the ‘immanent’ Trinity), and vice versa.
quotes/justin-day-called-sunday/text: And on the day called Sunday, all who live in cities or in the country gather together to one place, and the memoirs of the apostles or the writings of the prophets are read, as long as time permits; then, when the reader has ceased, the president verbally instructs, and exhorts to the imitation of these good things.
quotes/cranmer-preface-1549/text: There was never any thing by the wit of man so well devised, or so sure established, which in continuance of time hath not been corrupted ...
quotes/luther-deutsche-messe-para/text: Luther explained that he offered the German Mass for the sake of the unlearned and the young, kept the Latin service for those who knew Latin, and imagined a third, simpler order for earnest Christians meeting in houses; he warned that no order of service should be made into a binding law or a means of salvation.
quotes/calvin-worship-para/text: Calvin argued that God rejects all modes of worship not expressly sanctioned by his word, since people who devise worship by their own judgement, however good their intentions, end up honouring their own inventions rather than God.
